timeConvention.source_label_field: Date Local + Time Local; Date GMT + Time GMT
timeConvention.hour_interval_semantics: EPA defines hourly timestamps as the beginning of sampling; local fields use fixed local standard time (PST, UTC−8), not daylight-saving time.
timeConvention.utc_conversion: Use the supplied Date GMT + Time GMT directly; verified against every local timestamp plus 8 hours.

quality.seasonalEligibilityRule: At least 75% valid hourly observations annually and in every UTC meteorological season
quality.missingTreatment: null; no interpolation, imputation or averaging of collocated monitors
quality.negativeTreatment: The app consistently excludes negative concentrations. All 18 original negative readings are retained in the source audit; EPA's own statistics may retain negatives and consequently differ.
quality.boundaryNote: The public 2024 file is indexed by local standard year. Its last eight local-year hours occur in UTC 2025; the first eight UTC-2024 hours would require the 2023 local archive and remain null. LocalYear retains all genuine 2024 local timestamps.
quality.qaStatus: EPA's 2024 annual summary marks this hourly POC 3 series Certified. The comparison excludes 18 reported negative hourly values under its consistent nonnegative rule and retains informational fireworks/wildfire observations. The site's daily FRM POC 1 is primary; these hourly FEM benchmarks are educational comparisons, not official site design values.
quality.certificationEvidence: annual_conc_by_monitor_2024.zip, parameter88101/POC3/sample-duration1HOUR; not an independent certification audit
quality.eventTreatment: Retain 48 IH fireworks hours and one IT U.S. wildfire hour: EPA classifies both codes as informational. No request-exclusion, null-data or QA qualifier appears in the selected hourly records. The annual hourly summary reports Event Type 'No Events'; this denotes no exclusion-event partition, not an absence of informational source flags. No EPA event-exclusion claim is made.
quality.regulatoryInterpretation: The site's daily FRM POC 1 is its NAAQS primary monitor. The current South Coast AQMD survey permits use of hourly POC 3 for annual comparisons when manual observations are missing. The current July 2026 comparability appendix requests exclusion of POC 3's 2025 data after a 2023–2025 bias assessment; it does not establish an exclusion of this 2024 series. This extract neither combines collocated monitors nor reproduces official site design values.
quality.sourcePrecisionNote: Original reported decimal concentrations retained; EPA truncation is applied only by the separate benchmark calculation.
quality.sampleDurationEvidence: EPA hourly-file specification and matching annual 1 HOUR monitor summary
quality.spatialScope: One monitoring location; not a citywide or population-weighted exposure estimate
quality.selectionReason: Single POC 3, parameter88101, FEMmethod170; high hourly capture across all four seasons
quality.license: Public domain US EPA AQS monitoring data
